lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated intensity intersecting with the primary horizontal rows of spots to form a coordinate-like grid.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features on the upper third of the flank showing distinct light-above-shadow-below pixel gradients.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin in the lower right foreground exhibits a high density of small, discrete high-luminance spots.
